headline: On October 30, 2005: Dresden Frauenkirche reconsecrated
captionCards: Rebuilt using some of the original stones
Symbol of reconciliation and peace today
instagramCaption:
Dresden's iconic Frauenkirche rises from the ashes. \\[The rebuilt Frauenkirche, a Lutheran church in Dresden, was reconsecrated after a 13-year rebuilding project following its destruction during the Allied firebombing of Dresden in World War II. The reconstruction, which began in 1994, used some of the original stones from the rubble. Today, it stands as a symbol of reconciliation and peace. \\Why do you think this church is so important to Dresden? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
